claims: Artemis II launched successfully on April 1, 2026, at 22:35:12 UTC (6:35:12 p.m. EDT) from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II carried four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II's journey was a 10-day, 865,000-mile journey around the Moon.
Artemis II splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The rocket for Artemis II was the Space Launch System (SLS).
The crew of Artemis II was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II's mission goal was the first crewed flyby of the Moon in over 50 years.
